movement_rating.description: A 0–10 decision-support score combining weather, seasonal deer behavior, food, estimated hunting pressure, and recent harvest activity. It is not a guarantee.

best_window.description: The strongest upcoming legal-daylight morning or afternoon window based on hourly NOAA weather. Confirm local season hours before hunting.

harvest_activity.description: Current cumulative KDFWR Telecheck totals for the selected county, plus change since the previous daily snapshot. Live data reports male and female, not exact antler status.

food_outlook.description: A confidence-adjusted regional mast baseline from the latest available KDFWR survey. Confirm current acorns, crops, browse, and fresh sign where you hunt.

hunting_pressure.description: An estimate based on season events and holidays, day of week, and regional public-land exposure. It is not a measured hunter count.

county_tactic.description: A county-level starting plan combining a generalized landscape profile with current weather, food, and pressure. Property-level terrain and deer sign should control the final setup.

limitations: Weather is sampled at three representative communities per region; the best window uses hourly weather from one representative point.
The latest available 2025 mast survey is a low-confidence East/West baseline, not a claim about current 2026 mast conditions.
Hunting pressure is an estimated index based on calendar effects and relative public-land exposure, not measured hunter counts.
County habitat profiles are generalized landscape archetypes, not parcel-level mapping.
KDFWR live harvest results report male and female deer; male should not be presented as exactly equivalent to antlered.
Current harvest automatically falls back to neutral if KDFWR data cannot be retrieved or validated.
The score is decision support, not a guarantee of deer movement.

pressure.interpretation: Higher pressure_index means more estimated hunter pressure; score is inverted for forecast movement.
limitations: This is an estimated pressure index, not a measured hunter count.
Public-land exposure is a relative regional proxy and does not measure private-land access or local crowding.
Season dates are configuration data and must be reviewed against each annual KDFWR hunting guide.
